title: salvia officinalis subsp. oxyodon
intro: Salvia officinalis subsp. oxyodon, commonly known as Red Sage or Greek Sage, is a subspecies of the Salvia officinalis plant, native to the mountainous regions of Greece and Turkey. Red Sage is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to support respiratory health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Red Sage include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective effects, which may contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as Alzheimer's disease and anxiety disorders. The bioactive constituents of Red Sage include polyphenolic compounds like ursolic acid, rosmarinic acid, and camphor, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
